title: Does checkpoint A's papyrus -> air (Z_out) ranking of ink generalize? New Frag4 ROIs, Frag1, Frag3
status_before_labels: Frag1 and Frag3 ink labels not downloaded; Frag4 labels open since phase 12 but ROIs 0, 1, 3, 4, 6, 7 never evaluated; no phase 13 score computed
label_of_results: exploratory; Frag1 and Frag3 were Kaggle 2023 training fragments and their exclusion from A's lineage is not attested

regions.rule: phase11_geometry.select_patches on the published mask (1/8 grid); 1024 x 1024 px at 2.215 um from the 3.24 um surface volume, as phase11_z_frag4.prepare
regions.support: mask eroded by 16 output px and Hann weight >= 25 % of maximum
regions.exclusion: a ROI with fewer than 1000 valid positive or 1000 valid negative label pixels is reported but left out of the pooled tests

direction.rule: label-free: median over the 8 patches (64 x 64 px, inside mask) of the standard deviation of each surface-volume layer; the end (layers 0-12 or 52-64) with the lower mean value is air
direction.positive_control: Frag4 must come out with air at layers 52-64 (phase 11 geometry); otherwise the rule is void and phase 13 stops
direction.use: Z_out = papyrus -> air, Z_in = air -> papyrus, physically, in every fragment; planes mirrored about layer 32 when air is at layers 0-12
direction.surface_layer_check: z of surface_volume.ppm at a masked pixel must be 32

intensity: W2 per fragment, phase11_window rule: mean and std of layers 11..53 on 128 x 128 px around the 8 patches, inside mask, matched to 0.379 and 0.148 (single window, no secondary)

labels.source: inklabels of each surface directory, same grid mapping as the CT input, nearest neighbour

scores.B1: non-learned: 1 - mean of input planes 30 and 31 / 255 (darker surface = ink, sign from phase 12)
scores.B2: non-learned: local standard deviation (Gaussian sigma 4 px) of the mean of input planes 26..35, / 255

metrics.pooling: per fragment, included ROIs concatenated; block bootstrap 64 x 64 px, 499 draws, seed 208, same draws for every score (paired differences)
metrics.per_roi: point estimates of every metric, reported for all ROIs

hypotheses.H3: per fragment: lower 95 % bound of pooled ROC-AUC(Z_out) > 0.5
hypotheses.H4: per fragment: lower 95 % bound of the paired difference PR-AUC(Z_out) - PR-AUC(Z_in) > 0
hypotheses.H5: per fragment: lower 95 % bound of the paired difference ROC-AUC(Z_out) - max(ROC-AUC(B1), ROC-AUC(B2)) > 0, the baseline chosen per bootstrap draw
hypotheses.generalization: claimed only if H3 holds in all three fragments

not_allowed_after_labels: changing ROIs, direction rule, window, scores, exclusion rule or hypotheses
reporting a subset of fragments or ROIs
